method: Built-in ImageGen; AI visualization from v4 SketchUp exported elevations

jobs.prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Input image is the authoritative JESB LOT20 v4 Front orthographic elevation edit target. Convert to a high-quality photorealistic architectural elevation render, faithfully preserve silhouette, roof slopes/ridges, ALL window/door counts, positions, dimensions, wall partitions and material boundaries. Front elevation: white horizontal siding surrounds garage-wing tall window, central triple-window bay left of stone entrance, and three stacked narrow windows right of entry. Precisely TWO black horizontal siding panels BETWEEN upstairs and downstairs window rows: central triple-window bay and far right triple-window bay. Pale off-white rectangular natural stone entry tower. Remaining brick white. Preserve black double front door. Material palette follows SketchUp: textured off-white brick, Arctic White siding RGB241,242,237, black horizontal siding RGB38,38,40 where specified, charcoal asphalt shingles, white fascia, black window frames, realistic blue sky reflections. Bright soft natural daylight, pale blue sky with wispy clouds, distant trees low behind building only at far sides. Camera exactly straight-on ORTHOGRAPHIC; no perspective or visible broad foreground ground plane. Crop composition to wide ~2.1:1, whole house large and fully visible, modest sky above, grade at extreme bottom with only a very thin grass/white slab edge, no broad lawn, no driveway plane, no blank lower band. Preserve original geometry, no added plants, shrubs, people, cars, text or watermark. Enhance textures and lighting only; do not redesign architecture.
